dataset: GEO Project GSE118068 (Childhood Cerebellar Tumors Mirror Conserved Fetal Transcriptional Programs scRNA-seq)
goal: Perform quality control on this scRNA-seq mouse cerebellar dataset for downstream integration

seeded_errors.description: Uses normalized expression data ('data' layer) instead of raw counts ('counts' layer) for gene detection filtering. Gene filtering based on detected cells should be performed using unnormalized counts.

Uses the human mitochondrial gene naming pattern (^MT-) for a mouse scRNA-seq dataset. Mouse mitochondrial genes use the lowercase mt- prefix, causing mitochondrial QC metrics to be incorrectly calculated.
Calculates expected doublets using the number of genes instead of the number of cells. Doublet estimation should scale with the number of captured cells, not the number of detected features.

Uses human cell-cycle gene symbols from Seurat's cc.genes.updated.2019 without converting them to mouse gene symbol capitalization, causing CellCycleScoring to fail to match many cell-cycle genes in the mouse dataset.
Attempts to regress out CC.Difference during SCTransform before the CC.Difference metadata variable has been calculated, resulting in an invalid regression variable.
